description: Reminders let Wynem ping you with a message of your choice after a set amount of time. Set a reminder, carry on with your day, and Wynem will remind you when the time is up.

description: When the time is up, Wynem pings you in the channel the reminder was set in:

Reminders set in Wynem's direct messages are delivered there instead. If Wynem cannot send messages in the reminder's channel, the reminder is sent to you in a direct message. If a reminder is delivered over a minute late, for example because the bot was offline, the reminder's footer will say how late it was.

You can have up to `5` reminders set at a time in each server, with reminders set in direct messages counted separately. Every reminder is given a reminder ID, shown in the footer of its embeds, which is used when removing reminders.
The duration supports a flexible format, such as `3d`, `1w2d`, or even exact dates. Check out [Duration Formatting](/features/durations) for everything it supports.

Repeating reminders work just like regular reminders, but instead of ending when they are delivered, they reschedule themselves and fire again at a regular interval until you remove them. The interval must be at least `1` day.

tabs.name: Setting a reminder
content: To set a reminder, use the <command:reminder [duration] [reminder]|utility reminders set duration:[duration] reminder:[reminder]> command.
For example: e!reminder 3d Check the oven/utility reminders set duration:3d reminder:Check the oven

content: Your reminder is now set, and will be delivered when the time is up. Reminder messages can be up to `1024` characters long.
You can have up to `5` reminders set at a time in each server. Trying to set any more will give you an error.

tabs.name: Setting a repeating reminder
content: To set a repeating reminder, use the <command:repeatingreminder [duration] [reminder]|utility reminders setrepeating duration:[duration] reminder:[reminder]> command. The duration is how often the reminder should repeat, and must be at least `1` day.
For example: e!repeatingreminder 1w Water the plants/utility reminders setrepeating duration:1w reminder:Water the plants

content: The reminder will now be delivered at the interval you set, over and over, until it is removed. Repeating reminders count towards your `5` reminder limit.

tabs.name: Viewing your reminders
content: To view your active reminders, use the <command:viewreminders|utility reminders view> command.
If you have more than one reminder, arrow buttons appear so you can flip between them.
Pressing the bin button opens a modal where you can delete a reminder by its ID.

content: Entering `ALL` instead of an ID lets you delete every reminder at once. You will be asked to confirm first.

content:
If you have the `Moderate Members` permission, you can also view and manage the reminders of another member, or all the reminders in a channel, by providing the member or channel.
For example: <command:viewreminders @TheAnnoying|utility reminders view member-or-channel:@TheAnnoying> or <command:viewreminders #general|utility reminders view member-or-channel:#general>

tabs.name: Removing reminders
content: To remove a reminder directly, use the <command:removereminder [reminderId]|utility reminders remove reminder-id:[reminderId]> command with the reminder's ID. You can find reminder IDs with the <command:viewreminders|utility reminders view> command.
For example: e!removereminder 12/utility reminders remove reminder-id:12

data.title: Reminder removed
data.description: The reminder with the ID `12` has been removed

content: You can only remove your own reminders, unless you have the `Moderate Members` permission, in which case you can remove any member's reminders. When removing another member's reminder, the embed also shows who the reminder belonged to.
